comments.text: MOPS signature and the length-prefixed name DISK. Page 0, not this page, supplies the C00BH initializer and the C00DH function table.

CLI command table. Each record is a length, the name, and a little-endian handler. A 00H length ends the table. Names: CD, MD, RD, DEL, ERA, VOL, DIR, DOS, REN, CLS, VAR, LDIR, COPY, DATE, HELP, TIME, MOVE, TYPE, LTYPE, MVDIR, RNDIR, CHDIR, ERASE, MKDIR, RMDIR, ERASE, FORMAT, RENAME.
Eight-byte character bitmap placed immediately before the CD handler at C2A9H.
NUL-terminated directory tag: space, <dir>, two spaces.
Nine-byte separator table, scanned with CPIR.
Unused FFH fill through the end of the page.
